safety.title: ⚠️ Safety — read before going live
safety.p1: Strobe effects can trigger photosensitive epileptic seizures, even in people with no history. Always warn the audience before a show with strobes.
safety.p2: Light Maestro caps strobe at a safe level (“strobe limit” setting, 10 by default, 25 max). Only raise it when the venue and audience allow it.
safety.p3: You remain solely responsible for public use. When in doubt: no strobe.
safety.ofl: Fixture definitions: Open Fixture Library (MIT license) — open-fixture-library.org
safety.appLine: Light Maestro — DMX lighting control software

quickshow.chaserHint: The chaser plays its own fixtures and takes over from the autoscript during its range, then hands control back.
quickshow.chaserTrackHint: Chaser track: imports a chaser that takes over its fixtures during its range
quickshow.createChaserHint: Create one in Design → Chasers, then try again.

quickshow.createSceneHint: Create one in Design → Scenes, then try again.
quickshow.createShowHint: Create one in Design → Show, then try again.
quickshow.crossfadeHint: Set the transition time between your colors here. A higher value gives progressive morphing, ideal for soft atmospheres.
quickshow.forceDropTitle: Force a drop (max energy + strobe for 300ms)
quickshow.generateStyleB: Generate B cues with different style for comparison
quickshow.gradStep1c: . It will be the dominant hue for this cue.
quickshow.gradStep2c: different for a progressive gradient, or identical for a flat hue.
quickshow.importAioHint: Import an All-In-One structure (.json produced by scripts/allinone_import.py)
quickshow.matrixHint: The RGB matrix takes over its fixture group during its range (pattern, colors, speed as defined in RGB Matrix), then hands control back to the autoscript.
quickshow.matrixTrackHint: Matrix track: plays an RGB matrix that takes over its group during its range
quickshow.musicStyleHint: Music style: rhythmic structure of the show (movement patterns, strobe, intensity per section). “Auto” follows the detected genre from the audio analysis.
quickshow.noAudioConfirm:
⚠️ No audio available for “{{name}}”.

The .lmpreset will be written WITHOUT audio — if a file with the same name already exists containing audio, it will be OVERWRITTEN without audio (permanent loss).

⚡ First reload the audio in the sidebar (New audio file),
then re-export.

Continue anyway without audio?
quickshow.noCustomEffectNoMatch: ⚠ No effect matches this group / fixture. Pick another target or create an effect for these fixtures.
quickshow.noCustomEffectNoTarget: ⚠ No custom effects. First create a movement effect in the EFX tab.
quickshow.paletteSectionHint: Per-section palettes override the active palette for those sections. The AutoScript panel also allows contextual editing.
quickshow.paletteHint: Color palette: only the visual range (color wheels / RGB) changes. “Auto” detects the dominant color from the audio analysis.
quickshow.presetSaveFailed: Preset save failed: IPC bridge not loaded.
quickshow.repairMissing: ✘ {{file}}: audio “{{expected}}” not found — reload it then re-export
quickshow.repairSummary: {{total}} preset(s) — OK: {{ok}}, repaired: {{repaired}}, audio still missing: {{missing}}, errors: {{errors}}
quickshow.scanPresetsHint: Scans a folder of .lmpreset files and re-embeds missing audio from the cache
quickshow.sceneHint: The static scene takes over from the autoscript during its range (like a chaser but with the scene's exact channels), then hands control back.
quickshow.sceneTrackHint: Scene track: imports a static scene that takes over its fixtures during its range
quickshow.showHint: The full show takes over from the autoscript during its range (like a chaser but for the whole show).
quickshow.showTrackHint: Show track: imports a full show that overrides the autoscript during its range
quickshow.snapOffTitle: Snap OFF: free placement (click to enable)
quickshow.snapOnTitle: Snap ON: aligned to beats (click to disable)
quickshow.ttABEx: Generate style B (house) then switch with A (techno) to pick the vibe.
quickshow.ttABText: Switches between two generated cue styles (A and B) to compare lighting moods.
quickshow.ttClearText: Clears the timeline and arrangement (cues, sections, EFX, tracks). Audio stays loaded.
quickshow.ttDmxText:
Toggles DMX output to hardware.
When off, the 3D view keeps rendering but nothing is sent to hardware.
quickshow.ttDropEx: At the peak of a chorus or a musical drop.
quickshow.ttDropText: Triggers a sonic/visual “drop”: max energy + strobe for ~300 ms.
quickshow.ttDryEx: Use it to prepare your show before the real stage.
quickshow.ttDryText: Simulates DMX output without sending real data to hardware. Safe test setup.
quickshow.ttFreezeEx: Pause the show run to inspect a precise state.
quickshow.ttFreezeText: While Freeze is on, the current DMX frame is held (playback paused).
quickshow.ttGenBEx: Tested at full techno vs house energy without redoing everything.
quickshow.ttGenBText: Creates an alternate version of the cues with a different music style, for one-click comparison.
quickshow.ttNewAudioEx: Ideal for starting a new track: load the sound → the app creates the 8/16/32 zones.
quickshow.ttNewAudioText: Loads a new audio file (mp3/wav), detects the BPM and auto-slices it into sections.
quickshow.ttOpenText: Loads a saved .lmpreset project (fixtures + audio + timeline).
quickshow.ttPresetsText: Save, reload or export your .lmpreset setups (scenes, EFX, linked audio).
quickshow.ttRedoText: Reapplies the change you just undid.
quickshow.ttSaveEx: Do it regularly so you don't lose your work.
quickshow.ttSaveText: Saves the entire current state (scenes, EFX, show, audio, positions) to the project file.
quickshow.ttSnapText: ON: moving/resizing a section or track block snaps it to detected beats (pink waveform dots, timeline bars). OFF: free placement.
quickshow.ttUndoText: Undoes the last timeline or edit change.
